$comment: The roles the knowledge graph knows how to lay out, and the predicates it knows how to draw. A workspace maps each role it uses to a class of its own ontology in its graph map; it never changes this file.

initiative.label: Initiative
initiative.description: A funded body of change that groups epics toward a shared goal

need.label: Need
need.description: What someone needs done: a use case, an opportunity, a demand item

capability.label: Capability
capability.description: An ability the organisation has or wants, at any level

increment.label: Capability increment
increment.description: A stated, testable step in a capability, reached in one period

period.label: Period
period.description: A planning period: a quarter, a sprint, a programme increment

epic.label: Epic
epic.description: A sized piece of work in one period, made of stories

story.label: Story
story.description: One unit of an epic's work, small enough to finish in a sprint

deliverable.label: Deliverable
deliverable.description: A named product of work that someone accepts

deliverable-type.label: Deliverable type
deliverable-type.description: A kind of deliverable from a register, with its standard and size

product.label: Product
product.description: A consumable surface others build on or use

request.label: Request
request.description: A request raised against a product

pattern.label: Pattern
pattern.description: A recurring solution, at any scope

building-block.label: Building block
building-block.description: A reusable architecture or solution building block

other.label: Other
other.description: A record whose role the graph map does not name
